pages.text: An Orderstone is an Arcane Gem formed from a pink-spectrum piece of $(l:items/shaped_quartz)Shaped Radiant Quartz$() in an oval cut.$(br2)When activated, an Orderstone transforms certain blocks into a more orderly state.$(br2)To recharge a dun Orderstone, collect experience globes while holding the gem.

pages.title: Transformations
pages.text: The following transformation sequences can be performed:$(br2)Sand $(arrow) Coarse Dirt $(arrow) Dirt $(arrow) Mycelium $(arrow) Podzol $(arrow) Grass Block$(br2)Gravel $(arrow) Cobblestone $(arrow) Stone$(br2)Mossy Cobblestone $(arrow) Cobblestone $(arrow) Stone$(br2)Cracked Stone Bricks $(arrow) Stone Bricks $(arrow) Chiseled Stone Bricks$(br2)Mossy Stone Bricks $(arrow) Stone Bricks $(arrow) Chiseled Stone Bricks$(br2)Damaged Anvil $(arrow) Slightly Damaged Anvil $(arrow) Anvil$(br2)Furnace $(arrow) Lit Furnace
